basis: Cardiomyopathy and hypogonadism define the syndrome; ptosis and toe phalangeal aplasia each occur in 80-99%; isolated reported skin findings omitted.
Bilateral congenital absence or hypoplasia of the patellae.
Lymphoid cell malignancy arising in orbital structures; lymphoma also requires the immune mechanism axis.
Cowden mucocutaneous hamartomas, including oral papillomas, define the phenotype; thyroid carcinoma reported in 6/7 is a separate associated cancer.
Epithelial tumour of the thymic gland, classified here as an endocrine gland neoplasm; associated autoimmune disorders are separately diagnosed.
Developmental impairment of language function belongs to the neurodevelopmental axis.
Carcinoma originates in eyelid epithelium; the concept includes both ocular and cutaneous carcinoma.
Inherited hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; conduction abnormalities and arrhythmias remain within the cardiac axis.
Inflammation of maxillary sinus mucosa; this acute/chronic umbrella does not establish a uniformly infectious or autoimmune cause.
Malignant tumour arising in the larynx; smooth muscle histology does not establish skeletal muscle involvement or an infectious cause.
Splenic congestion causes blood-cell destruction and pancytopenia; portal hypertension characterizes Banti syndrome. Underlying cirrhosis is separate.
Skin/nail abnormalities, oral leukoplakia and marrow failure define classic disease; pulmonary fibrosis affects roughly 20% in classic DC, with variable rates across TBD.
Acquired peripheral axonal neuropathy; monoclonal gammopathy does not establish autoimmune causation. Muscle wasting reflects denervation rather than primary myopathy.
Lymphoid malignancy involving the retroperitoneum; this location alone does not establish renal or gastrointestinal invasion.
Hepatic porphyrin metabolic disorder; blistering photosensitive skin disease affects roughly 50-70% of symptomatic patients. Persistent neuropathy is not reliably >=30%.
Genetically classified mature B-cell lymphoma; no additional organ location is specified.
Renal tubular salt wasting, hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and sensorineural deafness define this Bartter subtype; weakness does not establish intrinsic muscle damage.
Inherited cardiac electrical disorder causing a shortened QT interval and susceptibility to arrhythmias.
Hereditary chronic inflammation and damage of the exocrine pancreas; secondary diabetes is a separate disease.
Squamous carcinoma originates in the glottic larynx; possible late extension does not establish common damage to another axis.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with abnormal sperm morphology and motility; no endocrine or other axis involvement is established.
Treponemal infection defined by an inoculation-site chancre with cutaneous or mucocutaneous ulceration; other organ damage is not characteristic of this stage.
Tuberculous infection of the gastrointestinal tract, predominantly ileum and cecum; hepatic disease is a minority subtype.
Intraepithelial malignancy of vulvar skin with eccrine/apocrine differentiation; associated anorectal or urothelial cancers occur in 10-20% and are separate diseases.
Aneurysmal enlargement of the abdominal aorta; downstream organ ischemia is a complication rather than defining common involvement.
